summary: Discord OAuth app registration is done through the Developer Portal and is immediately usable for basic scopes. No approval wait for standard apps; verification is only required for privileged intents or apps in 100+ servers.

steps.text: Go to https://discord.com/developers/applications and log in with your Discord account
Click 'New Application', enter an app name, and create it
Navigate to the 'OAuth2' tab in the left sidebar
Add your redirect URI(s) under 'Redirects' (must use HTTPS, except localhost)
Select required OAuth2 scopes (e.g., identify, email, guilds)
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret for use in your code

blockers: Redirect URIs must use HTTPS (localhost with HTTP is allowed for development)
Apps requiring privileged intents (presence, message content, guild members) need verification after reaching 100 servers
Rate limits apply to API endpoints; OAuth2 token endpoint has its own limits
Client Secret must be kept confidential; can be regenerated if compromised
